cardOverview.overviewText: A Movies & More card offering discounts on movie tickets, dining privileges, and lifestyle benefits for entertainment lovers.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Box office comes at your doors tep with 4 movie tickets worth INR 250 each at BookMyShow You get a benefit of INR 1,000 redeemable in 2 transactions of INR 500 each and maximum of 2 tickets in each transaction.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
